items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I've done a few with Mr. Page.

ctx.x: Just about, and doing them, you know. I worked with the young musicians, I record rock and roll, I still play the bebop, you know. As I say I'm totally involved in music. Oh, gosh, I've done so many rock beats for Capitol and Motown, you know. Oh, I've done a few with Mr. Page. I said that advisedly. You know, and what's the -- oh, gosh, I don't know who these people are, Pat, you know, I mean I come out of there and with my wawa and my synthesizer and all of this. My -- you know, I have to carry all this…
